_comment: plan-quests.md C4, quest 2 of 4 — the harvest verb. D2: harvest-N is kill-N of a harvest species, so this rides the same lifetime counters as a wolf cull; the Turnip is damageable ONLY by a `harvest`-tagged aura, which is the one the Farmer teaches in the same conversation. Six turnips stand in the row north of him and respawn on 600 ticks, so five is a chore rather than a wait. Reward: 150 XP. Prose cut ≥50 % + trackers authored with conversation-journal Q4.
title: The Turnip Row

stages.journal: Five turnips out of the north row before the boars get them. Not by hand — the farmer will show me how it is done if I ask.
Five turnips out of the ground. The farmer will want to count them.
He counted all five and allowed that the row would have rotted without me. From a farmer, that is thanks.
